sections.title: Filters and following
paragraphs: Filter by level, event, channel, endpoint, text and time range. The event is the engine's event name, such as channel.started or delivery.state_changed; it is matched whole, so a part of a name finds nothing. Follow shows new events as they arrive; scrolling away from the newest event or opening a row pauses it and counts what you missed. Jump to live shows them and follows again. Open a row for its event, target, sequence, message and fields; its channel, endpoint and message link to their pages.

sections.title: When the engine goes away
paragraphs: While the connection is down the page waits and follows again by itself. Events logged meanwhile are read from the engine's log and shown once, above a divider that gives the times. If the engine restarted, or its log no longer holds the whole outage, the divider says so; after a restart the earlier events can no longer be loaded.

sections.title: Limits
paragraphs: The viewer holds the newest 10,000 rows; Load older fetches earlier events a page at a time. Once the window is full, Show events before opens a time range that ends before the oldest row. Message bodies are never logged.
